question: What is the meaning of adaptability in relation to technical information?
description: Adaptability in relation to technical information refers to the ability of data to be modified or adjusted to meet changing requirements or conditions. This could involve updating data to ensure it remains accurate and relevant, or altering data structures to accommodate new types of data or relationships between data. In the context of ISO 59040, adaptability could also refer to the ability of a product to be upgraded or updated to extend its useful life or meet future user requirements. <||>
